newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks in London end slightly firmer.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks in London end slightly firmer.

text.p: Hong Kong shares firmed in London on Thursday with some interest in bank stocks in an otherwise dull trading day, dealers said.
The Hang Seng London Reference Index rose 22.77 points or 0.15 percent to close at 14,818.29.
"We saw some buying from UK investors into the banking sector," one trader said, adding bank stocks were the most actively traded shares today.
The Hang Seng Index in Hong Kong fell 36.06 points, or 0.24 percent, to end at 14,795.52 after a choppy trading day, dominated by profit-taking and bargain-hunting.
